text:
mia: quick sync—proposal for inbound routing SLA: introduce a 'degrade mode' when enrichment latency exceeds threshold. behavior: assign to fallback queue to keep the pipeline flowing, but mark the lead with owner_sticky=true so the original owner remains associated and gets notified once enrichment completes. thoughts? :thinking:
jordan: agree with degrade mode. threshold idea: 12s instead of 10s to avoid flapping on partner spikes.
sam: observed enrichment p95=9s, p99=21s last week. 12s seems reasonable for most customers, but we should make it configurable per integration.
ravi: technically we can extend owner TTL in HubSpot webhook handling to 3m, but that feels risky on top of sticky flag. prefer sticky flag + short TTL bump.
cleo: on Salesforce we can add a lightweight 'claim_hold' checkbox custom field via API to prevent automatic reassignment. low risk. I'll prepare the PR.
ops-bot: deploy checklist:
- HS workflow update pushed to staging
- SF mapping PR created and reviewed
- Canary rollout plan (region + account segment)
- Dashboard for owner_reassign_rate + enrichment_latency tagged
mia: Canary suggestion: start in EMEA, SMB accounts for 24 hours, then USA SMB, then broader. escalate rollback if owner_reassign_rate > 0.7% or SDR reopen rate spikes.
jordan: workflow pseudo:
```
if enrichment_latency > THRESHOLD:
  move lead -> fallback_queue
  set lead.claim_hold = true
  tag lead: owner_sticky_original=<owner_id>
  notify original_owner via email + slack
``` 
sam: add metrics: enrichment_latency_by_connector, owner_reassign_rate_by_segment. create an alert if reassign rate > 0.5% for 15m.
mia: UX note: when owner is moved to fallback, send a short email to owner: "We routed [lead] to fallback due to enrichment delay. You're still the owner; we'll restore after enrichment completes." keeps SDRs in the loop.
ravi: question: how do we restore ownership? ops-bot: suggested restore flow: when enrichment completes, call HS API to remove claim_hold and reassign to owner_sticky_original if still available; otherwise leave in fallback.
cleo: ETA for SF PR + HS workflow patch: EOD today. I'll add migration to set claim_hold=false for existing leads.
mia: I'll update the handoff playbook and compose short runbook for oncall (rollback commands, key dashboards). will also add a list of escalation contacts.
jordan: ping eng-sre to monitor the canary and own rollback. @eng-sre any objections?
eng-sre: we'll watch owner_reassign_rate and have rollback playbook ready. plan to be on-call during first 3 hours of canary.
sam: final ask: add a short analytics event when we enter degrade mode so growth/ops can measure impact on conversion.
mia: agreed — we'll emit event degrade_mode.enter and degrade_mode.exit with reason tags. will post PR links here when ready.
